lines.zh: 我只有半格长，游得却很稳。
lines.en: I'm only half a block long, and I swim steady.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，在沙上留下一道浅痕。
lines.en: My tail leaves a shallow line in the sand.
I follow the groove along the riverbed.
When the water's shallow I keep to the bottom.
I slip under a stone.

lines.zh: 我游过一段干河床的倒影。
lines.en: I swim past the reflection of a dry riverbed.
My fins are small and beat quickly.
I head for the weeds.
I'm at ease in this river.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底的石子往前挪。
lines.en: I work forward over the river gravel.
I swim very low, almost on the sand.
The water's cooled; I slow down.

lines.zh: 我从河湾的静水里穿过。
lines.en: I cross the still water of the bend.
One tail flick and I'm in a crevice.
I come into the shallows. Bright light.
I swim forward and don't look back.
I hang by the weeds without moving.
I open my mouth and take a little.

lines.zh: 沙落在我背上，薄薄一层。
lines.en: A thin layer of sand settles on my back.
My scales are thin as paper.
A pebble rolls past and I move aside.
A leaf is sinking.
I move aside and it settles.
The stones here are all mossy.
I'm in a patch of shade.

lines.zh: 有只大鱼游过去，我不动。
lines.en: A big fish passes. I don't move.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼根本没往这边看。
lines.en: The big fish never looked this way.
There are advantages to being small.
I fan my tail lightly to hold position.
I can stay on this bottom.

lines.zh: 你的脚在水里，比石头大。
lines.en: Your feet in the water are bigger than stones.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边，只有半格长。
lines.en: I'm by your feet, half a block long.
You bend down and I back away.
I'm not worth reaching for.
I'll swim off and you can't stop me.
This shallow river can't hide me.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里露出半条身子。
lines.en: Half of me shows from the crack in the rock.

lines.zh: 你的影子把水都压暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow darkens the whole pool.
You don't look like you eat fish.
Then we'll go our separate ways.
I dart off and dart back.
A scale has come off.
The water's cloudy and I can't see.
I hide in a crevice and don't come out.
The pain keeps me on the bottom.
Even my tailbeat is off.
That's more than enough for me.
The blood in the water is very faint.
I'll hide for a while.
I'll come out when the water settles.
Something landed on the surface.
Small. Just one mouthful.
I rise and take a look.
I've never tasted that.

lines.zh: 我绕着这块骨头游了一圈。
lines.en: I circled this bone once.
One touch and it sinks.
I wait underneath.
I wait for it to soften in the water.
Then I come up for a bite.
Thank you. That's enough.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的脚趾上，滑开。
lines.en: I bump your toe and slide off.
That muddied the water.
I roll over and right myself.
Your foot moves and I dart away.

lines.zh: 你的靴子扫过，我贴沙伏下。
lines.en: Your boot sweeps by and I press flat to the sand.
In the water I'm quicker than you.

lines.zh: 我这条鱼小得像片叶子。
lines.en: I'm a fish the size of a leaf.
I pull free and lose a few scales.

lines.zh: 被你的靴子一碰，我翻了个身。
lines.en: Your boot turned me over.
I swim back to where I was.
Others of my kind are behind the weeds.

lines.zh: 我们很小，聚在一起才看得见。
lines.en: We're small. Only together are we noticed.
They fan their tails and I fan mine.
The eggs will settle in the roots.

lines.zh: 我们不守，那么多也守不住。
lines.en: We won't guard them. Too many for that.
The water will carry the eggs.

lines.zh: 这条河里的鱼，都是这么来的。
lines.en: That's how the fish in this river come.

lines.zh: 我们游在一起，像一片小云。
lines.en: We swim together like a small cloud.
When a big fish comes, we scatter.
And gather again after.
I bite. A very small bite.
This bit has sand on it.
I hold it in my mouth and let it pass.
I eat the scraps on the bottom.
What sinks is mine.
Too hard. I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我这副肺鱼牙，专啃硬壳。
lines.en: These lungfish teeth are for hard shells.
Enough. I sink down.
I rest against the bottom a while.
Then I swim on.
Some scraps are drifting in the water.
I rise a little and see them clearly.
They're sinking.
A layer of leaf fragments settles on the water.
A few tailbeats from here.
No big fish nearby.
I circle halfway first.
Only then do I go over.
These are the sinking bits.
This little mouthful is enough.
I fan my tail along the sand toward it.
I open my mouth for one bite.
I follow the scraps.
They turn in the water.
It turns, and I turn with it.
One settles by a stone.
I go along the bottom.
My fins touch the sand.
It's right ahead.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一张一合，喝到了。
lines.en: My mouth opens and closes. I taste it.
My movement stirs it.
I bite, and it slips free.
One tailbeat and I dart after it.
I've got it in one bite.

lines.zh: 我含着那点碎屑，又吐掉。
lines.en: I hold the scraps in my mouth, then spit them out.
I bite. Too small to matter.
I ram it and can't move it.
That one, I'm the one who backs off.
I flick my tail. A tiny splash.
It moves and the surge throws me.
I snap at the water once.
A bit of my fin is torn.
I lie on the sand without a fin stirring.
It swims off. I stay put.
I swim out slowly.

lines.zh: 我撞在石头上，头有点晕。
lines.en: I hit a stone and my head spins.
I back into the weeds and hide.
I swim out of a rock crevice.
The river is shallow and clear.

lines.zh: 我先在底上停了一会儿。
lines.en: First I rest on the bottom a while.
Fine sand, slippery stones.
I test my tail with two strokes.
Light patches shift on the surface.
There are bigger fish further off.
I won't go that way.
I find a crevice and slip in.
I can see out clearly from here.

lines.zh: 河底有一层细沙，正好落脚。
lines.en: There's a layer of fine sand to rest on.
I try swimming upstream.
Too fast. I drift back.
Staying here suits me fine.
The water burns; I dig into the mud.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，鳃贴着干土。
lines.en: I'm flung ashore, gills against dry earth.

lines.zh: 水退到只剩一寸，我的鳃干着。
lines.en: The water's an inch deep and my gills are dry.

lines.zh: 炸响把河底的沙都掀了。
lines.en: The blast lifts the riverbed sand.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进水里，钉住我。
lines.en: An arrow comes into the water and pins me.
A light holds me still in the water.

lines.zh: 水底空了很久，我快撑不住了。
lines.en: The bottom's been empty so long I'm failing.

lines.zh: 闪电在水里散开，我翻了白肚。
lines.en: The bolt spreads through the water and I flip belly up.
No water. My tail does nothing.
